title: Unregistered Exit Portal Causes Game Progression Soft-Lock at Level Finish
explanation: Player navigated the full course of Level01, reaching exit terminus coordinates (7316.6, 159.96) at frames 13156 and 13300, but goal.found remained false and no portal_entered or level_completed event was emitted. Violates lifecycle progression contract (Portal2D.gd:L11-L16), trapping the player in an uncompletable level.
